candidate_program.name: local_greedy_switch
candidate_program.rationale: Separates favorable comparisons with a feasible packing of active rivals from normalized shortfalls. This local threshold is heuristic; constructing the greedy packing can be costly at high degree.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + neighbor_pack) if weight >= neighbor_pack else (weight - neighbor_pack) / (1 + weight + neighbor_pack)

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
